name: Federation of American Scientists
summary: A Washington DC science-policy organisation founded in 1945 by Manhattan Project scientists: its Nuclear Information Project counts the world's nuclear arsenals in the open, its Global Risk Program worked on AI and nuclear, biological and cyber risk, a small team works on AI safety and security policy, and most of its money goes to fellows placed in federal agencies, the Day One Project's policy proposals, research on climate and energy, government capacity, federal data and state and local government, and nine fiscally sponsored projects such as the Alliance for Learning Innovation.
